sourceNotes: Timings 1g warm/cold and 20g warm were bundled from the ece9-based working tree with the progress CPU helper. Exact bundle hashes, rather than a claim of a clean source commit, identify these measured artifacts.
The 20g cold run includes the final operator summary/progress source packet before its commit; its exact bundle SHA is recorded.
The 20g workers bundle was the 256KiB stream candidate before later additive CLI/resume metadata commits. The successful stream policy is unchanged.
The 1g workers bundle was rebuilt from the final ece9 engine branch. Helpers and Dockerfile/eviction C source are committed with the PR.
Images and bundle hashes identify local measured artifacts. No production credentials or identity files are part of this provenance.
